headline: Carrie is just trying to make a friend in the new trailer
summary: Mike Flanagan's Stephen King adaptation of 'Carrie' debuts October 7th on Amazon Prime. The new trailer, released at Comic-Con 2026, reveals updated elements. It promises a familiar yet refreshed take on the classic tale.

headline: You can get three months of Xbox Game Pass Ultimate for almost half off
summary: Xbox Game Pass Ultimate is available for nearly half price in a new deal. Get three months for $39.01, down from its usual $69 value. This digital code offer is currently available at Eneba.

headline: Marvel announces Ryan Gosling as Ghost Rider, a new Black Panther, and more
summary: Marvel revealed Ryan Gosling is joining the MCU as Ghost Rider at Comic-Con. A standalone Ghost Rider film, directed by Shawn Levy, is slated for 2028. Other Comic-Con announcements included a new Black Panther.

headline: The vertical video takeover is here
summary: Vertical video has achieved widespread dominance across social and media platforms. This 'Stepback' newsletter analyzes the shift to vertical formats. The article details how vertical video became pervasive in the tech world.

headline: Which Ghost Rider Is Ryan Gosling Playing in the MCU? | Comic Con 2026
summary: Ryan Gosling is confirmed as Ghost Rider in the MCU, sparking speculation on his specific iteration. The article explores theories about which Ghost Rider he will play. It also discusses how former MCU Ghost Riders might be retconned.

headline: Kevin Feige Says Ryan Gosling Approached Him With a 'Specific Vision' for Ghost Rider in the MCU
summary: Ryan Gosling will officially star as Ghost Rider in the MCU. Kevin Feige revealed Gosling approached him for the role. Gosling reportedly has a 'specific vision' for the character's portrayal.

headline: IDW Teases an Exciting New Era for Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles | Comic Con 2026
summary: IDW is ushering in an 'exciting new era' for Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles comics. The flagship series will undergo a significant transformation in 2027. Writers discussed upcoming developments at Comic-Con 2026.

headline: Resident Evil Director Knows RE2 Didn't Have Snow or iPhones, But He 'Took Liberties' to Make the Movie Better
summary: Resident Evil director Zach Cregger addressed fan criticism regarding his new movie. He acknowledged lore inaccuracies like snow and iPhones in 'RE2'. Cregger defended his choices, stating he 'took liberties' to enhance the film.

headline: What we know so far about the Berlin Pride ramming attack
summary: A car rammed into a crowd at a Berlin Pride event on Saturday night. Police have launched a manhunt for the suspect. Details are still emerging about the attack in the German capital.

headline: Burnham says he is prepared to call out Trump 'if right for Britain'
summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated he's prepared to challenge US President Trump if it serves Britain's national interest. He emphasized the importance of defending national interests. Burnham had a productive first conversation with Trump.

headline: Andy Burnham rules out early election in exclusive BBC interview
summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham ruled out an early general election. He made the announcement in an exclusive BBC interview. Burnham affirmed his commitment to honoring the manifesto voters supported.

headline: Gatwick Airport left without running water after major outage
summary: Gatwick Airport is experiencing a major running water outage. Bottled water is being distributed to passengers and staff. Investigations are currently underway to resolve the issue.
